thread:
Priya (Content): Quick post-launch SEO sync — heatmap + redirects + schema + webinar page. Need: final kw list, schema for webinar & benchmarks, internal link map, redirect plan, and inbound lead routing (HubSpot forms). Can we lock these today? :rocket:

Sam (Dev): on it. Can you drop the redirect mappings? I'll roll a small netlify/nginx patch. Also will add canonical headers on the landing page.

Jon (SEO): I'll prioritize keywords into primary/secondary/longtail. Suggestion: 1) "low-latency LLM inference" 2) "inference cost optimization" 3) "on-prem LLM serving". Will produce a 1-pager for content/engineers.

Marta (Growth): Webinar page: we need clear lead flows. HubSpot form -> hidden field for "region" + utm_source. Also add event for webinar_reg via GA4 and gtag. For routing, route enterprise leads to AE queue if company_size > 50.

Ava (Marketing): Messaging iteration: let's do 3 headline variants for the launch post and 2 benchmark narratives (cost-first and latency-first). We'll A/B test CTAs and measure CTR -> signups.

Priya (Content): I'll finalise longtail kw and seed internal linking anchors. Proposed internal link plan: product overview -> benchmarks -> docs -> webinar. Anchors: "production inference", "cost per token", "private deployment".

Sam (Dev): here's a quick redirects snippet I can use (Netlify _redirects style):

```
# redirects
/old-product /product 301
/beta /product 302
/webinar-2026 /events/webinar-2026 301
```

Sam (Dev): For nginx rewrite if we need server-side:

```
location /beta {
  return 302 /product;
}
```

Jon (SEO): Also add JSON-LD for webinar schema. Quick example:

```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Launch + Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-04-15T16:00:00Z",
  "location": { "@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.ai/events/webinar-2026" }
}
```

Marta (Growth): Can we attach tracking params to redirect rules? e.g. add ?utm_campaign=launch&utm_source=redirect for social shares.

Sam (Dev): Yes, I'll append query params where appropriate. Will push to staging and share deploy link.

deploy-bot: Redirects patch deployed to staging — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:

Ava (Marketing): OK — next steps: Priya to final kw list by EOD, Jon to hand off schema JSON-LD + canonical check, Sam to deploy redirects to prod after staging signoff, Marta to wire webinar lead routing and AE queue rules, I'll build headline variations and set experiment. Checkin at 4pm. :eyes:

Priya (Content): On it. Sharing draft kw sheet in #docs shortly.

Jon (SEO): will add canonical example and internal link anchor spreadsheet.

Sam (Dev): tagging @Jon @Priya when pushing redirect PR.

Marta (Growth): noted. I'll prepare the HubSpot workflow and routing doc.

Ava (Marketing): thanks team :rocket: — tiny ask: capture one benchmark narrative that maps to SEO pillar pages (cost/perf). We'll iterate in the 4pm sync.

Priya (Content): ACK — will include examples and CTAs for each pillar.
